title: [CQ-M01] Execution profile configuration
description:
Objective: Add legacy/observe/verified-local profile configuration and effective policy snapshots without enabling an unimplemented trusted profile.

Deliverable: Execution profile configuration. This is task M01 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): none.
definitionOfDone: Absent profile preserves current deliveryPolicy; observe never weakens current policy.
Malformed/unknown profiles are rejected; verified-local activation fails closed until certified readiness exists.
Task/attempt policy snapshot integration is explicit and old active tasks cannot silently acquire or lose strict trust.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.author: architect-cq-coordinator
comments.content: Execution sizing refinement: child [CQ-M01a] owns the 5-file typed profile/configuration foundation. This parent retains durable task/attempt policy snapshots, anti-forgery and lifecycle enforcement; it must not be marked complete merely because profile primitives exist. Strong activation remains unavailable until all isolation/evidence/client gates pass.
